description: Full record for one Notting Hill place by slug: the guide's description and tip, address, coordinates, opening hours, website and the public /place URL. Use it for hours or an address, and for the coordinates of a station or landmark before calling nearby_places. openNow says whether the place is open at londonTime by its listed hours (null when the hours cannot say); to answer what is open now, call it for each candidate. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.
name: get_place
title: Get a Notting Hill place
